candidates.name: Pea-Green Textured Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The actual color reads muted khaki rather than pea green, while the dropped shoulder, twin-layer styling and boxy overshirt construction look daytime Casual rather than Party.

candidates.name: Anchor-Red Heavyweight Tee
candidates.decisionReason: The anchor red is useful, but the very wide long tee, large chest volume and crossbody styling read generic streetwear rather than a controlled Spring evening look.

candidates.name: Pink Button-Down Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution review shows loud broad stripes, an oversized mismatched chest pocket, long rounded tails and heavily rolled cuffs; the pattern overwhelms rather than refines the outfit.

candidates.name: Yellow Button-Down Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The mustard color is cheerful, but the visibly crumpled washed fabric, conventional button-down collar and rolled-sleeve denim styling read basic Casual rather than modern Night Out.

candidates.name: Red Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The hanger-only image gives no body proof and the shiny semi-sheer red fabric plus white underlayer looks cheap and costume-like.

candidates.name: Sauce-Purple Sweatshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The purple is attractive, but the dropped shoulder, very long sweatshirt body and oversized chest pocket create the baggy-top silhouette explicitly excluded.

candidates.name: Gum-Leaf Roll-Sleeve Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The long tunic-like body, deep open neckline and rolled sleeves read Resort cover-up rather than a structured Spring Party shirt.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated crop provides no rise, seat, full-leg or hem proof and appears short; it cannot support a Party approval.

candidates.name: Navy Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The leg is visibly broad and puddles over the sneaker, while dark navy would return the outfit to a heavy default lower half.

candidates.name: Military-Green Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The wrinkled product-only image lacks fit proof and the small multicolor hardware makes the trouser look casual and low-quality.

candidates.name: Yellow-Green Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The acid yellow-green wash, very wide leg and heavy sneaker stacking create a loud baggy streetwear bottom instead of refined Party color.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution review exposes an elastic drawstring waist, loose lounge fabric and rolled barefoot hems; it is pajama-like rather than Party tailoring.
